sentences.text:
The instant petition has been filed praying for a direction to the respondents to pass a fresh award
by treating the acquired land as non agricultural and decide the representation dated 22.06.2023 by
a speaking order.

2.  The respondents are in receipt of instructions, according to which, the award of the acquired land of the petitioner was made on 19.01.2023 under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
